facts.fact: Official Nara tourism distinguishes JR Nara from Kintetsu-Nara and JR West from Kintetsu. Indicative train times are52min OsakaStation→JRNara and34min Osaka-Namba→KintetsuNara; different starting points, not door-to-door or guaranteed departures. Suica/ICOCA usable on both with rail-pass restrictions. Osaka and ShinOsaka/JRNamba/OsakaNamba are not interchangeable.
